title: Engineering synergy sprint check-in — cross-team huddle
body:
Date: 2026-06-09
Time: 09:30–10:15 PT
Location: Zoom / #eng-leads Slack
Facilitator: Aanya Patel (Platform Eng)
Note taker: Mei Zhang (Serving Runtime)

Attendees:
- Aanya Patel (platform-engineering)
- Liam O'Connor (serving-runtime)
- Mei Zhang (serving-runtime)
- Diego Rivera (observability)
- Priya Nair (private-deployments)
- Samir Khan (infrastructure)
- Joined late: Carla Mendes (product-hosted-api)

Purpose: quick cross-team alignment on sprint-21 blockers that threaten next-week milestones, confirm rollouts for the cache-prefetch feature, and triage a recent production regression in the dedicated control plane.

Agenda summary:
1) Quick status updates from each area (60s each)
2) Dedicated control plane regression triage (15m)
3) Cache-prefetch rollout readiness and canary plan (10m)
4) Cross-team dependencies & action item assignment (10m)
5) Parking lot / risks (5m)

Notes and key discussion points:
- Rapid updates:
  - Serving Runtime (Liam): perf tests for v10.3 kernels show ~6% throughput regression on 4k context for a narrow model subset; investigation points to a memory-path change in the new allocator. Running targeted benchmarks on NVLink nodes today. (See JIRA-ENG-8932)
  - Observability (Diego): tracing rollout for token-level latency is on schedule; initial dashboards ingest is noisy—working on samplers. Asking teams to identify one production trace example for debugging this week.
  - Private Deployments (Priya): two customers in legal review for VPC onboarding; need confirmation of Private control-plane key rotation schedule before they sign.
  - Infrastructure (Samir): capacity for dedicated pools is tight for week of 6/16; cloud quota increase is approved but node spin-up still constrained by AMI bake backlog.

- Dedicated control plane regression (major item):
  - Symptom: several Dedicated customer clusters reported intermittent 503s between 06/05–06/08 during steady traffic. Error pattern: control-plane healthcheck probe failed intermittently; pods restarted and reconciled normally.
  - Triage so far: logs show transient DB connection timeouts correlated with a spike in reconciliation loops after rollout of RBAC change (CON-1452).
  - Short-term mitigation agreed: roll back the RBAC patch on the private control plane candidate branch in staging and pause canary for dedicated clusters until fix is validated. Aanya to coordinate rollback with platform release engineers.
  - Long-term fix: add backpressure to reconciliation controller and implement circuit-breaker for DB queries; Samir and Liam to pair on design doc. Estimated cycle: 5 working days.

- Cache-prefetch rollout (medium priority):
  - Status: feature branch merged to canary; canary agent on 3% of hosted traffic, initial latency drop observed for prompt-heavy workloads.
  - Concern: KV cache warm-up increases upstream token load for first requester causing bursty load on dedicated pools.
  - Canary plan update: increase sampling to 8% for hosted only; do not enable on Dedicated and Private until we validate backpressure. Priya to confirm private policy constraints.
  - Rollout gating criteria (agreed): 1) sustained 5% latency improvement on p50/p95 for targeted workloads; 2) no >2x variance in token spikes to dedicated pools; 3) observability dashboard alerts stable for one week.

Cross-team dependencies / asks:
- Serving Runtime -> Infrastructure: urgent request for two additional NVLink 8x nodes to reproduce 4k context regression at scale. (Owner: Liam; target date: 2026-06-12)
- Private Deployments -> Product: need firm key rotation schedule to present to two customers in pipeline. (Owner: Priya; target date: 2026-06-11)
- Observability -> All teams: provide 2–3 representative trace examples and associated request ids to help debug noisy ingest. (Owner: Diego; target date: 2026-06-10)
- Platform Engineering -> Release Eng: coordinate RBAC rollback and patch validation in staging. (Owner: Aanya; target date: 2026-06-10)

Action items (explicit):
1) Aanya P. to open rollback PR for RBAC patch and coordinate staging validation; link PR in slack #releases. Due 2026-06-10. (Aanya Patel)
2) Liam O'C to run focused 4k-context benchmarks on 2 NVLink nodes and post artifact to the perf bucket. Due 2026-06-12. (Liam O'Connor)
3) Samir K. + Liam O'C to draft design for reconciliation backpressure + DB circuit breaker; include capacity implications. Due 2026-06-16. (Samir Khan, Liam O'Connor)
4) Priya N. to confirm private control-plane key rotation policy and customer-facing timeline; escalate to security if gaps. Due 2026-06-11. (Priya Nair)
5) Diego R. to share dashboard queries and request example traces in convo in #observability and upload two example traces to Confluence (CON-1452). Due 2026-06-10. (Diego Rivera)
6) Product (Carla M.) to provide acceptance criteria for cache-prefetch behavior on Hosted vs Dedicated customers. Due 2026-06-11. (Carla Mendes)

Decisions made:
- Pause canary on Dedicated and Private for cache-prefetch until backpressure controls are in place.
- Rollback RBAC patch in staging as immediate mitigation for dedicated control-plane 503s.

Risks and unresolved questions (parking lot):
- Risk: if NVLink nodes are delayed, reproducing the regression will push timeline for hotfix; contingency: use a cloud spot pool with equivalent interconnect for temporary repro. (Owner: Samir)
- Question: is our token-level tracing retention sufficient for long-running regressions? Diego to propose retention tweak and cost estimate.
- Unresolved: final SLA customer communication language for the dedicated incident. Customer Success and Legal need to review the draft note; Aanya to set up a separate sync.

Follow-ups / next meeting:
- Quick sync next Tuesday 2026-06-16 09:30 PT to review RBAC rollback outcome and perf reproducer results.
- Weekly cross-team leadership recurring: same time Tuesdays.

Appendix / useful links referenced in meeting:
- JIRA: JIRA-ENG-8932 (serving runtime perf regression)
- Confluence: CON-1452 (Private control plane RBAC rollout notes)
- GitHub PR: github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/1287 (allocator tweak branch)
- Slack threads: #dedicated-ops (incident thread), #observability (traces)

Notes to self: capture the rollback playbook steps in a short runbook; mark the dedicated incident as a learning review once hotfix is validated.

End of notes.
